EnableNpcGenerator.Name: Enable NPC Generator
EnableNpcGenerator.Hint: Adds a tab to NPC sheets that randomly rolls a name, instinct, and trait.

EnableMonsterGenerator.Name: Enable Monster Stat Generator
EnableMonsterGenerator.Hint: Adds a tab to NPC sheets that randomly rolls a damage die, armor, HP, and coin.

EnableAttackAssistant.Name: Enable Attack Damage Automation
EnableAttackAssistant.Hint: On a success or partial success for a melee (Hack & Slash) or ranged (Volley) move, asks whether to roll damage and automatically deducts consumables like ammo.

MeleeMoveNames.Name: Melee Move Names
MeleeMoveNames.Hint: Move names (comma separated) that should trigger the damage prompt as a melee attack. Adjust this if a translation module renamed the move.

RangedMoveNames.Name: Ranged Move Names
RangedMoveNames.Hint: Move names (comma separated) that should trigger the damage prompt as a ranged attack. These also trigger the ammo consumption prompt.

RangedWeaponTags.Name: Ranged Weapon Tags
RangedWeaponTags.Hint: If a weapon's tags contain any of these keywords (comma separated), it's treated as ranged. Weapons have no explicit melee/ranged field; this relies on the Dungeon World convention that melee weapons use hand/close/reach and ranged weapons use near/far. Default: near, far.

TagMenu.Name: Damage Tag Automation
TagMenu.Label: Edit Tag List
TagMenu.Hint: Individually toggle which weapon tags are automatically applied when rolling damage.

Npc.RollButtonTitle: Randomly re-roll this NPC's name, instinct, and trait. Can be repeated any number of times.

Monster.RollButtonTitle: Randomly re-roll this NPC's damage die, armor, HP, and coin.

Attack.WeaponLabel: Which weapon did you attack with?
Attack.NoWeapons: {name} has no weapon equipment; skipping the damage roll.
Attack.ApplyFullTitle: Apply full damage to selected tokens (Dungeon World system feature)
Attack.ApplyHalfTitle: Apply half damage to selected tokens (Dungeon World system feature)
Attack.ApplyDoubleTitle: Apply double damage to selected tokens (Dungeon World system feature)
Attack.ApplyHealTitle: Apply healing to selected tokens (Dungeon World system feature)

DamageBonus.Label: +N damage (e.g. +1 damage) — auto-applied by the damage buttons

Piercing.Label: N piercing (e.g. 1 piercing) — auto-applied by the damage buttons (reduces armor)

IgnoresArmor.Label: Ignores Armor — auto-applied by the damage buttons

Forceful.Label: Forceful — shown as a note only
Forceful.Note: Forceful: you can knock them back or off their feet

Messy.Label: Messy — shown as a note only
Messy.Note: Messy: forces a losing side into a hard choice

TagSettings.Title: Damage Tag Automation
TagSettings.Hint: If a checked tag is present on the weapon, its raw text is shown in the damage roll message. Tags marked "auto-applied by the damage buttons" (damage bonus / piercing / ignores armor) are picked up by Dungeon World's own full/half/double/heal damage-apply buttons when clicked — the system reads the message text itself; this module doesn't calculate anything. Those buttons apply to whichever tokens are selected on the canvas (not targeted), and require the Dungeon World system setting "Enable Damage Buttons" to be on (default: on). Tags marked "shown as a note only" (Forceful/Messy) have no system automation, so they're just displayed for the GM to judge.
